about.description: Stable is a tokenization platform bringing the US mortgage market onchain. Issues USDX (USD-pegged, mortgage-backed stablecoin) on Solana, Ethereum, Base, and Monad, and EURX (EUR-pegged equivalent) on Base. Reserves comprise Fannie Mae / Freddie Mac agency MBS, tokenized residential mortgages, and real-estate-backed assets. Holders can stake USDX/EURX to earn yield generated by underlying mortgage interest, MBS coupons, and real-estate cashflow. Mint and redeem via app.trystable.co/swap against USDC (USDX) or EURC (EURX). Oracles: Chainlink. Reserves and contract addresses published on trystable.co/reserves.
about.registryInfo: Stable Inc. (operating as Stable Finance) is a US-based mortgage-finance fintech, founded by Winston Robson, that tokenizes Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac mortgage-backed securities (MBS), residential mortgages, and real-estate-backed assets onchain. Issues USDX (USD-pegged) and EURX (EUR-pegged) stablecoins, fully backed by the underlying MBS / mortgage / real-estate portfolio.
